reason: B is slightly better because it more explicitly connects Cu@Gr treatment to the stated phase-separation/void limitation, defines processing parameters and comparative measurements, and combines the demonstrated Cu@Gr effect with newer evidence on coated-powder Cu-network homogenization. Both remain highly derivative of prior Cu@Gr work and inadequately specify irradiation dose and heat-flux boundaries, while B’s claims about suppressing Cu evaporation/dewetting and irradiation stability still require validation.
